text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I uploaded a draft benchmark narrative + 3 chart variants to the drive. Need: hero copy, 2 social captions, visual pick, and inbound routing. Webinar tie-in planned for next Thurs. Thoughts?

 tom: Saw the files. Quick ask — can we get a single two-panel hero: (1) latency distribution heatmap, (2) tokens-per-dollar microtable? Less is more.

 alyssa: I like the two-panel. Also propose a scatter for the in-depth post (latency vs cost per token). Headline options?

 evan: Draft headline idea: "Ship smarter: lower per-token cost for real-time apps." Might be too broad — recommend "Reduce per-token cost while keeping sub-50ms latency (typical workloads)."

 maria: Good call. Language should be conservative: use "typical customer workloads" and include a methodology link/footnote. Webinar CTA: "Live demo + cost calculator".

 tom: Routing note — webinar registrants -> sales (MQL); downloads of cost calc -> growth ops (trial outreach). Please add UTM and form field guidance.

 alyssa: Designers: @design-bot can you mock 3 hero variants (heatmap+table, scatter+cta, compact stat card) and export JPG + fig?

 design-bot: ack — will produce 3 hero mocks and one mobile crop by EOD Wed. Please confirm raw CSV for charts or I'll use the drive screenshots.

 maria: Send raw CSVs (latency samples, token counts, cost model) — also include the 3 story bullets for each chart. I'll draft the hero 1-liner and two social captions.

 evan: Social caption suggestions: 1) short: "Faster responses, lower cost. See how we benchmark latency vs token economics." 2) LinkedIn: longer narrative + CTA to webinar.

 tom: Sample UTM to use in assets: ?utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=latency_cost_2026. Add form fields: company_size, infra_preference, primary_use_case.

 alyssa: Quick product constraint: All claims must tag the model/config used (model name, quantization, batch) — include a single-line note under charts.

 maria: I'll loop in legal for signoff on claims. Schedule: landing+email+social+webinar next Thurs. Owners: maria=registration & copy, alyssa=hero copy+visuals, evan=webinar script, tom=inbound flow/tracking.

 evan: A/B test plan: headline emphasizing "latency" vs "cost"; CTA variant: "See demo" vs "Try cost calc".

 tom: I'll wire the inbound flow doc and create the tracking spreadsheet.

 maria: Awesome — thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post updated assets by Tue AM and ping for final signoff.
